title: Boao Forum for Asia publishes a Beijing organizational location
summary: The current organization-managed LinkedIn profile lists a Beijing primary location. Platform metadata labels Beijing as headquarters, while the same profile narrative says Boao is the permanent headquarters; the relation is therefore bounded to public office location.

data.subject: starintel:org:boao-forum-for-asia
data.note: LinkedIn primary location is current platform evidence for an organizational office. The conflicting platform headquarters label is not promoted over the charter distinction.
